Investigate reconciling items, unusual movements, and period-on-period variances; document the analysis and root cause; discuss findings with relevant teams; and monitor agreed adjustments or corrective actions through timely resolution.

Maintain visibility of key issues, owners, dependencies, and target dates; follow up on progress; communicate risks or delays; and escalate material or unresolved matters to the IFRS 17 & Project Lead to support timely and accurate delivery.

6. Monitor monthly balance sheet accounts reconciliations and aging.
Track the timely completion and review of monthly balance sheet account reconciliations, monitor the aging of outstanding reconciling items, follow up with relevant account owners on overdue or long-outstanding items, and escalate significant issues to support timely resolution and maintain balance sheet integrity.
